notes: Corrected: the supplied copula of the final clause moved from moshav to the fused mi-huts unit. moshavo is the subject and mi-huts la-mmahaneh the prepositional predicate, so rule 49 (and rule 20's ruling that an explicit subject takes only its own English) puts shall ... be on the preposition; the verse already reads 'asher ha-nega' bo this way at is in.
min plus huts still fuses in without under rule 30, and the fused unit is now discontinuous around the fronted subject (rule 25).
